note: Outside candidate list; John's report (9:38) is the occasion, as in linked Luke 9:49. The cup-of-water saying (9:41) matches Matthew 10:42 (AUD-47-13-20).

title: Have salt in yourselves and live at peace
speaker: Jesus
topic: The Little Ones and the Poor
note: Outside candidate list; 'everyone will be salted with fire' (9:49) leads into the salt saying of 9:50.

title: Jesus teaches on marriage and Moses’ permission to divorce
speaker: Jesus
note: Widen the Mark 10:6–12 link to 10:2–12: the testing question and Moses' certificate of divorce (10:4) open the teaching.

title: Jesus tells the rich man to keep the commandments
speaker: Jesus
recipient: a man who ran up and knelt
topic: The Commandments and the One Thing Lacking
note: Same exchange as Matthew 19:16–20 and the linked Luke 18:18–21; Mark's list adds 'do not defraud'.

title: Zebedee's sons ask for the places of honour in the kingdom
speaker: James and John, the sons of Zebedee
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 20:20–23; in Mark the brothers ask in person.

title: Seek greatness through serving others
speaker: Jesus
note: Direct parallel of Matthew 20:24–28; K054 links Mark 9:33–37 but not this passage.

title: Jesus has the blind man brought and tells him to receive sight
speaker: Jesus
recipient: Bartimaeus near Jericho, and the crowd
note: parallel to proposed B21 record Luke 18:40–42; 'Call him' (10:49) and 'Go; your faith has saved you' (10:52). Covers P02646.

title: Remove the goods and stop making the Father’s house a market
speaker: Jesus
recipient: those selling and buying in the temple
note: Outside candidate list; he 'would not allow anyone to carry a vessel through the temple' (11:16). K023 holds 11:17 as Study Context.

title: Jesus answers the challenge to his authority with John's baptism
speaker: Jesus, challenged by the chief priests, scribes and elders
recipient: the chief priests, scribes and elders
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 21:23–27; Mark has 'Answer Me' twice (11:29–30). Covers P02649.

title: The parable of the tenants warns those who reject the owner's son
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the chief priests, scribes and elders
note: parallel to proposed B21 record Luke 20:9–19; includes the rejected-stone quotation (12:10–11).

title: Give Caesar what is Caesar’s and God what is God’s
speaker: Jesus
note: Same exchange as Matthew 22:15–22 and the linked Luke 20:20–26.

title: Levirate marriage in an Israelite household
speaker: the Sadducees, citing Moses
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: The Sadducees cite the levirate law (Deuteronomy 25:5), as in the linked Luke 20:27–33.

title: The Lord's invitation to sit at his right hand
speaker: the Lord, quoted by Jesus from David
note: Quotation of Greek Psalm 109:1, as Matthew 22:44 and Luke 20:41–44.

title: Stay watchful because the time is unknown
speaker: Jesus
note: Outside candidate list. Widen the Mark 13:33–37 link to 13:32–37: no one knows the day or hour. 13:27 is prediction.

title: The council plots Jesus' arrest by stealth, avoiding the feast
speaker: the chief priests and scribes
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 26:3–5.

title: Leave Mary alone regarding the burial anointing
speaker: Jesus
note: Bethany anointing parallel to John 12:1–8: 'Leave her alone' (14:6) and the poor always with you (14:7).

title: Judas offers to hand Jesus over to the chief priests for money
speaker: Judas Iscariot
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 26:14–16; outside candidate list.

title: Woe to the one who hands over the Son of Man
speaker: Jesus
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 26:20–25.

title: The bread, cup, and remembrance at Jesus’ supper
speaker: Jesus
topic: Do This in Remembrance of Me
note: Mark's supper words ('Take; this is My body') are unlinked; Matthew 26:26–29 and Luke 22:15–18 are already linked.

title: Jesus tells the disciples to watch and pray in Gethsemane
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the disciples; Peter, James and John
note: Gethsemane parallel to Matthew 26:36–46 and the linked Luke 22:39–46; 14:36 is prayer. Covers 14:41–42 (P02659).

title: The Lord summons a sword against the shepherds
speaker: Jesus, quoting Zechariah 13:7
note: Outside candidate list; quotation of Zechariah 13:7 ('I will strike the shepherd'), as Matthew 26:31.

title: Judas signals the arrest with a kiss: 'Seize him'
speaker: Judas Iscariot
recipient: the crowd from the chief priests, scribes and elders
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 26:47–50; Mark adds 'lead Him away securely' (14:44).

title: Put the sword away at Jesus' arrest
speaker: Jesus (the record’s directive)
recipient: the disciple who struck with the sword
note: Mark narrates the sword stroke without Jesus' command; B21 links Luke 22:49–51 to the same incident.

title: The council condemns Jesus as liable to death for blasphemy
speaker: the high priest and the whole council
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 26:59–66.

title: Jesus' captors strike him and demand, 'Prophesy!'
speaker: council members and attendants
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 26:67–68.

title: Pilate offers the Passover custom of releasing one prisoner
speaker: Pilate
note: parallel to proposed B21 record John 18:38–40; the crowd asks him to do as he usually did (15:8).

title: Jesus’ accusers invoke their law in demanding his death
speaker: the chief priests, through the crowd
note: Same demand for crucifixion as John 19:6–7; B21 links Luke 23:18–23 the same way.

title: Pilate sentences Jesus to crucifixion at the crowd's demand
speaker: Pilate
note: parallel to proposed B21 record Luke 23:22–25; outside candidate list (15:15 is a context line).

title: Passers-by and leaders taunt Jesus to come down from the cross
speaker: passers-by, the chief priests and scribes, and those crucified with him
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 27:39–44.

title: Soldiers compel Simon of Cyrene to carry Jesus' cross
speaker: the soldiers
recipient: Simon of Cyrene, father of Alexander and Rufus
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 27:32; outside candidate list.

title: Bystanders say, 'Leave it; let us see whether Elijah comes'
speaker: a bystander at the cross
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 27:46–49.

title: Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus' body
speaker: Joseph of Arimathea
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Granted after the centurion confirms the death (15:44–45); Matthew 27:57–58, Luke 23:50–53 and John 19:38 are parallels.

title: The women are sent to report the resurrection
speaker: a young man in a white robe at the tomb
recipient: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome
note: Same charge as Matthew 28:5–7: 'Do not be alarmed... go, tell His disciples and Peter.'

title: Burn the prescribed incense morning and evening
speaker: the Lord’s ordinance, served by priestly custom
recipient: Zechariah, a priest of Abijah’s division
note: Zechariah's lot-chosen incense service carries out the incense ordinance (Exodus 30:7–8); the lot itself is priestly custom.

title: Gabriel tells Zechariah to name the child John
speaker: the angel Gabriel
note: The same message sets John's abstention from wine and strong drink (1:15; compare C0811 and Judges 13) and his Elijah mission (1:17).

title: Gabriel tells Mary to name her son Jesus
speaker: the angel Gabriel
note: Greeting (1:28), question (1:34) and consent (1:38) frame the naming command; compare AUD-44-1-20, which includes Joseph's compliance. Covers P02675.

title: Gabriel tells Zechariah to name the child John
speaker: Elizabeth and Zechariah, carrying out Gabriel’s order
note: Elizabeth's 'he shall be called John' and Zechariah's 'His name is John' carry out the order; link as Additional Scripture.

title: Circumcise newborn covenant males on the eighth day
speaker: the covenant law, kept by Zechariah’s household
note: Outside candidate list (context line); John's eighth-day circumcision follows Genesis 17:12 and Leviticus 12:3. Luke 2:21 is the same for Jesus.

title: Jesus identifies John with the messenger sent to prepare the way
speaker: Zechariah, prophesying in the Holy Spirit
note: Outside candidate list; Zechariah names his son's task, to go before the Lord to prepare His ways (Malachi 3:1; Isaiah 40:3).

title: The angel tells the shepherds not to fear, giving a sign
speaker: an angel of the Lord
recipient: shepherds in the fields near Bethlehem
note: Includes the shepherds' 'Let us go over to Bethlehem and see' (2:15), carried out in 2:16–17. Covers P02683.

title: Gabriel tells Mary to name her son Jesus
speaker: Mary and Joseph, carrying out the angel’s order
note: Outside candidate list; he 'was named Jesus, the name given by the angel' (2:21). Compare AUD-44-1-20 (Matthew 1:25).

title: Circumcise newborn covenant males on the eighth day
speaker: the covenant law, kept by Mary and Joseph
note: Outside candidate list; Jesus' eighth-day circumcision, as John's at Luke 1:59. The purification offerings (2:22–24) are already linked.

title: Paul recalls John’s instruction to believe in the one coming after him
speaker: John the Baptist
note: John's own announcement of the stronger One to come; B21 links John 1:26–27 and Acts 13:24–25 here.

title: Do not have sexual relations with your brother's wife
speaker: John the Baptist, rebuking Herod
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: Outside candidate list; John rebukes Herod about Herodias, his brother's wife, as the linked Matthew 14:3–4 and Mark 6:17–18.

title: The devil demands Jesus make bread, leap down and worship him
speaker: the devil
note: parallel to proposed B19 record Matthew 4:3–9; Jesus' answers (4:4, 4:8) are already linked to Deuteronomy records.

title: The devil demands Jesus make bread, leap down and worship him
speaker: the devil
note: parallel to proposed B19 record Matthew 4:3–9; the pinnacle demand quotes Greek Psalm 90:11–12. The answer (4:12) is C0996.

title: A prophet is not without honour except in his homeland
speaker: Jesus
note: Includes 'Physician, heal yourself' and the Elijah and Elisha examples; Mark 6:1–6 and Matthew 13:54–58 are parallels.

title: Jesus silences and expels the unclean spirit
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the unclean spirit in the Capernaum synagogue
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The crowd's 'With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits' (4:36) reports the same command.

title: Jesus tells those healed by him not to make him known
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the demons cast out at Capernaum
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: He rebuked the demons and would not let them speak, as Mark 1:34 and Mark 3:12.

title: Jesus tells Simon to put out deep and lower the nets
speaker: Jesus
note: K035 links only 5:8–11; the fishing order precedes the call. Compare proposed B21 record John 21:4–13. Covers 5:7 (P02692).

title: Jesus sends the healed man to the priest with the offering
speaker: Jesus
note: Widen the Luke 5:14 link to 5:12–14; 'be cleansed' (5:13) is already within the linked Mark 1:40–45.

title: Rise, carry the bed, and go home
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the paralyzed man, before the Pharisees
note: 'Rise and walk' (5:23) introduces the order of 5:24; he obeys in 5:25.

title: Jesus tells his critics to learn why God desires mercy
speaker: Jesus
note: Answer to the grumbling at Levi's feast (5:30), as Matthew 9:10–13; Luke: 'to call sinners to repentance'.

title: Love your enemies, do good, and lend freely
speaker: Jesus
note: The 'what credit is that to you?' contrasts (6:32–34) lead straight into 6:35.

title: Jesus appoints the Twelve to be with him and be sent out
speaker: Jesus
note: Outside candidate list; Luke's choosing and naming of the twelve apostles, parallel to Mark 3:13–19.

title: Examine yourself before judging another
speaker: Jesus
note: Fills the gap between the linked Luke 6:37–38 and 6:41–42: the blind guide and the disciple like his teacher.

title: Jesus sends the centurion home: as you believed, let it be
speaker: Jesus, petitioned through the centurion’s envoys
note: parallel to proposed B19 record Matthew 8:13; Luke has the envoys' petitions and Jesus' praise of faith but no command.

title: Wisdom is vindicated though this generation rejects John and Jesus
speaker: Jesus
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Matthew 11:16–19; 7:29–30 contrast the baptized tax collectors with the Pharisees.

title: Recognize the connection between forgiveness and love
speaker: Jesus
recipient: Simon the Pharisee and the woman
note: 7:48–50 complete the scene: 'Your sins are forgiven... Your faith has saved you; go in peace.'

title: Attend to what you hear
speaker: Jesus
note: Same lamp-and-hearing unit as Mark 4:21–25: 'watch how you hear', for whoever has will be given more.

title: Hear God’s word and do it
speaker: Jesus
recipient: those reporting that his family stood outside
note: The report that his mother and brothers stand outside (8:19–20) is the occasion; the linked Matthew and Mark accounts include it.

title: Jesus orders His disciples to cross to the other side
speaker: Jesus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: parallel to proposed B19 record Matthew 8:18; same order as Mark 4:35.

title: Jesus rebukes His disciples’ fear and little faith in the storm
speaker: Jesus
note: parallel to proposed B19 record Matthew 8:25–26; outside candidate list: 'Where is your faith?' (8:25).

title: Hear and hold the word with perseverance
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the crowd; explained to the disciples
note: Outside candidate list; the sowing itself (8:4–7) precedes the record's 8:8 start.

title: Jesus sends the pleading demons out into the herd of pigs
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the demons (Legion) in the Gerasene man
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: parallel to proposed B19 record Matthew 8:31–32; he was commanding the spirit to leave (8:29) and permitted the pigs (8:32).

title: The townspeople beg Jesus to leave their territory
speaker: the people of the Gerasene region
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: parallel to proposed B19 record Matthew 8:34; outside candidate list (8:37).

title: Jesus tells the healed woman to take courage: her faith saved her
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the woman with the flow of blood
note: parallel to proposed B19 record Matthew 9:20–22; Luke: 'Daughter, your faith has saved you; go in peace.'

title: Trust Jesus and care for the restored child
speaker: Jesus
note: The messenger's 'Do not trouble the Teacher any longer' (8:49) is what 'Do not fear; only believe' (8:50) answers.

title: Give the crowd something to eat
speaker: Jesus, answering the Twelve
note: The Twelve's 'Dismiss the crowd' (9:12) is the request Jesus answers with 'You give them something to eat.'

title: Peter proposes making three tents on the mountain
speaker: Peter
note: parallel to proposed B20 record Mark 9:5–6; 'not knowing what he was saying.'

summary: Matthew 10:17–Luke 9:33: 96 new (59 of them parallels of proposed B19/B20/B21 records), 30 extend, 72 parallel; main gaps are five unrecorded parables, Passion-narrative orders and decisions, Mark-only healing and secrecy orders, and many unlinked Synoptic parallels.
